Crab Research Outpost Stash — GTA 6 guide

Reported by a published guide · not personally verified Pelican Valley swamps, Mariana County

An abandoned research outpost in the swamp guards the biggest one-time cash grab of the early game.

Full guide — contains spoilers

The abandoned crab research outpost sits in the southwest corner of the Pelican Valley swamps in Mariana County, a short boat ride north of the Keys. Its three-code chain — computer password CLEAVES, safe 0072, dock door 0212 — leads to $1,070 in cash plus a stash bag holding $10,000 in marked bills, and a unique SMG. Because it is a one-time pickup, KeenGamer advises saving it until Chapter 2: anything looted in Chapter 1 is wiped when the chapter ends.

Source & evidence

Source: GTA 6 – Best Early Money Farming Spots and Secret Cash Stashes — KeenGamer.

Evidence: Early-money farming guide from search-indexed full text; codes corroborated by Vice City Hustle's checked list.. Marked bills must be fenced before they are spendable cash.
